gates.result: WALL (toolchain-libc++ build defect, NOT kernel): reaches AArch64 codegen, then BRK-traps at operator new(nothrow)
gates.serial: [KERNEL] FATAL: Unhandled EL0 Synchronous Exception! EC: 0x000000000000003C (BRK); [SELFHOST] phase=t24b-compile-fail reason=tool-rc rc=24576
gates.root_cause: libc++ -fno-exceptions + override detection: nothrow operator new asserts !__is_function_overridden<&operator new>; in clang-21's link _Znwm(0x100484e410) lies outside __lcxx_override [0x1004866cc0,..] => assert -> brk #1 at _ZnwmRKSt9nothrow_t+0x68 (0x1004842408: d4200020 brk #1). Not OOM (malloc never reached). Counter-proven healthy via the tiny NPNEW.BIN control.

gates.result: WALL (kernel-class): lld killed by an instruction fetch classified in=PROT
gates.serial: [KERNEL] pid=4 (/TOOLS/LLD2.BIN) memory fault VA=0x000000100064E000 PC=0x000000100064E000 rw=rx in=PROT -> killed
gates.root_cause_candidate: exec fault on a lazily-filled image page concurrently being filled by the L9 background prefetch; page walk says present (negative/pending leaf) so vm_handle_fault returns PROT instead of demand-filling. Timing-sensitive (clang survived its own prefetch). Kernel-side: lane w4-kernel owns.

summary.load_wall: FALSE ALARM (good news): the 126 MB load is not the wall — the v2 lazy loader maps it in ~0 ms and the L9 prefetch materialized 22,127 pages in 4.7 s while clang ran. Lane w4-kernel's L9 work is validated at the largest class.
summary.t23_wall: the staged /TOOLS toolchain binaries are raw ELF, executed as flat .bin (entry = file offset 0) => entry fault. The M2 objcopy -O binary conversion (documented in w3-tools as pending) is THE missing step; validated: flat conversion makes T2.3 pass.
summary.t24_wall: toolchain-libc++ build defect: -fno-exceptions override-assert traps on the FIRST operator new(std::nothrow) during codegen. Kernel has no BRK handling (correct for OS); the fix is toolchain-side.
summary.t25_wall: kernel-side: instruction fetch on a page mid-prefetch classified PROT => kill. Timing-sensitive; w4-kernel owns.
summary.secondary: deterministic kernel-mode fault in the pid=5 housekeeping process ([IDLESTUCK] probe) after every failed launch; the [IDLESTUCK] detector also false-positives the driver's legit pipe-wait.
summary.verdict_gap: a fault-killed tool can be reported rc=0 (t23): the EC=0x00/0x3C kill paths use process_exit() with stale x0 instead of process_fault_exit() => acceptance markers can false-pass a crashed tool.
summary.bottom_line: M2 last mile is NOT blocked by the loader; it is blocked by (1) the missing M2 flat .bin conversion (staging-side, 30-min task) and (2) a clang/libc++ link defect (toolchain-side). One kernel-side prefetch race to fix in w4-kernel.
